commands.title: Time tree
commands.description: Date the ancestors and estimate the clock rate from sampling dates.

settings.label: Alignment
settings.help: Aligned FASTA input. Accepts multiple plain or compressed (`gz`, `bz2`, `xz`, `zstd`) files and detects compression by extension. The records of all files form one alignment. Use `-` to read uncompressed FASTA from standard input.

settings.label: Tree
settings.help: Tree in Newick format.

settings.label: VCF reference
settings.help: Only for vcf input: fasta file of the sequence the VCF was mapped to.

settings.label: Metadata
settings.help: CSV/TSV file with metadata including sampling dates

settings.label: Metadata id columns
settings.help: Candidate column name(s) holding the taxon identifier that links metadata to tree tips
settings.more: The first listed column that is present in the header is used. Matching is case-insensitive.

settings.label: Metadata delimiters
settings.help: Candidate field delimiter(s) for the metadata table
settings.more: The delimiter actually present in the file is used. Defaults to comma, tab, and semicolon.

settings.label: Date column
settings.help: Label of the column to be used as sampling date (auto-detected when omitted)

settings.label: Date format
settings.help: Format used to parse string sampling dates (numeric, ISO, and uncertain dates parse regardless)

settings.label: Sequence length
settings.help: Length of the sequence, used to calculate expected variation in branch length. Not required if alignment is provided.

settings.label: Alphabet
settings.help: Sequence alphabet
settings.more: When omitted, the alphabet is auto-detected from sequence content and falls back to `nuc` when detection is ambiguous.

settings.label: Zero based
settings.help: Zero-based mutation indexing

settings.label: Amino-acid
settings.help: Use amino-acid alphabet (v0 compat, equivalent to `--alphabet=aa`)

settings.label: Clock rate
settings.help: If specified, the rate of the molecular clock won't be optimized.

settings.label: Clock rate std. dev.
settings.help: Standard deviation of the provided clock rate estimate

settings.label: Relaxed clock (slack, coupling)
settings.help: use an autocorrelated molecular clock. Strength of the gaussian priors on branch specific rate deviation and the coupling of parent and offspring rates can be specified e.g. as --relax 1.0 0.5. Values around 1.0 correspond to weak priors, larger values constrain rate deviations more strongly. Coupling 0 (--relax 1.0 0) corresponds to an un-correlated clock.

settings.label: Clock filter
settings.help: ignore tips that don't follow a loose clock, 'clock-filter=number of inter-quartile ranges from regression'. Default=3.0, set to 0 to switch off.

settings.label: Number of IQD
settings.help: Number of IQD (interquartile distance) for clock filter outlier detection

settings.label: Allow negative rate
settings.help: By default, rates are forced to be positive. For trees with little temporal signal it is advisable to remove this restriction to achieve essentially mid-point rooting.

settings.label: Tip slack
settings.help: excess variance associated with terminal nodes accounting for overdispersion of the molecular clock

settings.label: Covariation-aware regression
settings.help: Account for covariation when estimating rates or rerooting using root-to-tip regression

settings.label: Clock filter method
settings.help: Method for clock filter outlier detection (not yet implemented)

settings.label: Branch length mode
settings.help: If set to 'input', the provided branch length will be used without modification. Branch lengths optimized by treetime are only accurate at short evolutionary distances.

settings.label: No indels
settings.help: Disable indel (insertion/deletion) contributions to branch-length optimization and branch-length distributions.
settings.more: When set, branch-length optimization uses substitution-only likelihood and timetree branch distributions exclude the Poisson indel term. Matches standard phylogenetic tools (RAxML, IQ-TREE, PhyML, BEAST) and enables v0 parity testing. Default: indels enabled.

settings.label: Time marginal
settings.help: Control when marginal time distributions are used for output.
settings.more:
All modes use marginal inference during optimization. The mode controls whether confidence intervals are extracted from the resulting distributions:

- `never`: no confidence interval output (default) - `always`: write confidence intervals from distributions computed during optimization - `only-final`: run one extra inference pass after optimization, then write confidence intervals

settings.label: Date confidence intervals
settings.help: Add rate-uncertainty to confidence intervals.
settings.more: `--time-marginal=always` and `only-final` already write mutation-stochasticity CIs. This flag adds rate-uncertainty CIs (re-runs inference at rate +/- sigma), combined via quadrature sum. Requires `--covariation` or `--clock-std-dev`. When set with `--time-marginal=never` (default), automatically promotes to `only-final`.

settings.label: Max grid points
settings.help: Largest number of points of one probability grid during time inference.
settings.more: A run stops with an error when a grid would need more points. The value bounds single grids, not the total memory of a run. When unset, the run takes the limit of the app or server that runs it, otherwise 1000000.

settings.label: Iterations
settings.help: maximal number of iterations the inference cycle is run. For polytomy resolution and coalescence models max_iter should be at least 2

settings.label: Number of branches posterior
settings.help: add posterior LH to coalescent model: use the posterior probability distributions of divergence times for estimating the number of branches when calculating the coalescent mergerrate or use inferred time before present (default).

settings.label: Keep polytomies
settings.help: Don't resolve polytomies using temporal information.

settings.label: Resolve polytomies
settings.help: Resolve polytomies using temporal information

settings.label: Coalescent time scale Tc
settings.help: Coalescent time scale in years.
settings.more: Sensible values are on the order of the time from the root to the tips and are given in units of time.

settings.label: Optimize Tc
settings.help: Optimize coalescent time scale Tc to maximize coalescent likelihood.
settings.more: When set, TreeTime finds the optimal constant Tc analytically (closed-form maximum of the coalescent likelihood). This is similar to Python v0's `--coalescent=opt`, which used a numerical search.

settings.label: Skyline coalescent
settings.help: Use skyline coalescent model instead of constant Tc.
settings.more: Estimates a piecewise linear coalescent rate history. Requires --skyline-n-points to specify the number of grid points.

settings.label: Skyline number of points
settings.help: Number of grid points in skyline coalescent model.
settings.more: Only used when --coalescent-skyline is set. Defines how many piecewise linear segments are used to model Tc(t) over time. Must be at least 2. Matches Python v0's default.

settings.label: Skyline stiffness
settings.help: Smoothing stiffness for the skyline coalescent.
settings.more: Penalizes log-fold-changes of the coalescent time scale Tc between adjacent skyline segments: with z = ln Tc, the objective adds `(stiffness/2) * Σ (ln(Tc_{i+1}/Tc_i))^2`. Because it acts on log Tc, the stiffness is dimensionless and scale-independent. Larger values enforce a smoother Tc(t). Only used when --coalescent-skyline is set.

settings.label: Coalescent confidence
settings.help: Confidence level for coalescent time scale (Tc) bands, in standard deviations.
settings.more: Applies to every inferred coalescent mode (constant, --coalescent-opt, and --coalescent-skyline). The band spans `Tc * exp(±confidence * σ)`, where `σ` is the standard deviation of `ln Tc` from the coalescent likelihood curvature. A fixed --coalescent value is not inferred and therefore has no band.

settings.label: Gen per year
settings.help: Generations per year for converting the coalescent time scale Tc into an effective population size.
settings.more: The coalescent output reports an effective population size `N_e = Tc * gen_per_year`. Tc is already in calendar years, so this factor rescales it into generation units, the standard axis of a skyline plot. Only affects the reported `N_e`; it does not enter the inference.

settings.label: Plot tree
settings.help: filename to save the plot to. Suffix will determine format (choices pdf, png, svg, default=pdf)

settings.label: Plot root-to-tip
settings.help: filename to save the plot to. Suffix will determine format (choices pdf, png, svg, default=pdf)

settings.label: Tip labels
settings.help: add tip labels (default for small trees with <30 leaves)

settings.label: No tip labels
settings.help: don't show tip labels (default for trees with >=30 leaves)

settings.label: Reroot method
settings.help: Reroot the tree by temporal-signal optimization.
settings.more: Defaults to least-squares when rerooting is enabled. Use --keep-root to keep the input root.

settings.label: Reroot tips
settings.help: Reroot on the branch leading to a tip or the MRCA of a comma-separated tip list.

settings.label: Keep root
settings.help: don't reroot the tree. Otherwise, reroot to minimize the residual of the regression of root-to-tip distance and sampling time

settings.label: Substitution model

options.help: Infer GTR parameters from data via Fitch parsimony substitution counts.

settings.help: Substitution model to use
settings.more: `--model infer` infers a model from the data. Alternatively, specify the model type. If the specified model requires additional options, use `--model-params` to specify those.

settings.label: Model params
settings.help: Parameters for the model selected by `--model`, given as a `key=value` list
settings.more: Example: `--model k80 --model-params kappa=0.2 pis=0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25`.

settings.label: Custom GTR
settings.help: Load a custom GTR model from file (not yet implemented)

settings.label: Ancestral method
settings.help: Method used for reconstructing ancestral sequences

settings.label: Dense
settings.help: Use dense representation for sequences (store full probability distributions)

settings.label: Gap fill
settings.help: How to handle gap characters in input sequences
settings.more: 'only-terminal': replace leading and trailing gap characters with the ambiguous character (default, matches v0). 'all': replace all gap characters with the ambiguous character. 'none': leave all gap characters unchanged.

settings.label: Keep overhangs
settings.help: Do not fill terminal gaps (deprecated: use --gap-fill=none)

settings.label: Include leaves
settings.help: Emit reconstructed leaf (tip) sequences in addition to internal nodes.

settings.label: Impute missing data
settings.help: Resolve ambiguous and unknown tip states (`N` and IUPAC codes such as `R`) to the most likely inferred state. Gaps are left as deletions.

settings.label: Reconstruct tip states
settings.help: v0-compatible alias for `--include-leaves --impute-missing-data`.

settings.label: Report ambiguous
settings.help: Include branch mutations from or to the fully ambiguous nucleotide state `N`.
settings.more: By default these mutations are omitted from the branch mutations of the Newick and Nexus annotations and the Auspice JSON. Other ambiguity codes, such as `K` or `R`, are always reported. The MAT outputs store `N` as missing data and never contain these mutations.

settings.label: Divergence units
settings.help: Units for divergence values in augur node data JSON and auspice output.
settings.more: `mutations-per-site` (default): branch divergence as substitutions per site. `mutations`: count of reconstructed substitutions per branch that change the state: gaps, `N`, and ambiguity codes compatible with the parent state do not count. Requires ancestral reconstruction (incompatible with `--branch-length-mode=input`).

settings.label: Output augur node data
settings.help: Path to output augur-compatible node data JSON.
settings.more:
Contains per-node dates, branch lengths, clock model parameters, confidence intervals, and divergence metrics. The output is compatible with augur export v2 --node-data for Nextstrain pipeline integration.

Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output GTR
settings.help: Path to output GTR model JSON.
settings.more: Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output reconstructed nucleotide fasta
settings.help: Path to output reconstructed ancestral-sequence nucleotide FASTA.
settings.more:
The v1 equivalent of TreeTime v0's `ancestral_sequences.fasta`: internal-node sequences reconstructed by the marginal pass, plus reconstructed tip sequences when `--include-leaves` (or `--reconstruct-tip-states`) is set. `--impute-missing-data` resolves ambiguous tip states.

Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output clock model
settings.help: Path to output clock model JSON.
settings.more: Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output clock CSV
settings.help: Path to output clock regression CSV.
settings.more: One row per sample as the final clock model saw it: the date the regression used, marked `input` or `inferred`, the root-to-tip distance it regressed on, the date the model predicts from that distance, and whether the clock filter excluded the sample. Not written by default. Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output confidence TSV
settings.help: Path to output date-confidence-interval TSV.
settings.more: Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output tracelog
settings.help: Path to output iteration-statistics tracelog CSV (monitors convergence).
settings.more: Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output coalescent TSV
settings.help: Path to output the coalescent time scale as a flat TSV (one row per skyline segment).
settings.more: Written when a coalescent model is set (`--coalescent`, `--coalescent-opt`, or `--coalescent-skyline`). A fixed `--coalescent` writes one band-less segment over the tree span. Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output coalescent CSV
settings.help: Path to output the coalescent time scale as a flat CSV (one row per skyline segment).
settings.more: Written when a coalescent model is set. Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output coalescent JSON
settings.help: Path to output the coalescent time scale as a rich JSON document (inputs + segments).
settings.more: Written when a coalescent model is set. Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output all
settings.help: Write all default output files into this directory.
settings.more:
Produces the default set of tree and non-tree outputs for the command, using `<dir>/<command>.<ext>` paths. Combine with `--output-selection` to restrict which outputs are written.

Per-file flags (`--output-tree-nwk`, `--output-augur-node-data`, etc.) override or supplement the files produced by `--output-all`.

An output that the run has no data for is skipped without a message, for example the substitution model of a run that fits none. A per-file flag for such an output fails.

settings.label: Newick style
settings.help: NWK/Nexus annotation styles to write (comma-separated): `plain`, `beast`, `nhx`.
settings.more: Applies to every NWK and Nexus output. With more than one style, files are distinguished by a secondary extension (`.annotated` for beast, `.nhx` for nhx). Default: `plain`.

settings.label: Output tree Newick
settings.help: Path to output Newick tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`. With multiple `--output-nwk-style` values, a secondary extension is inserted per style.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree nexus
settings.help: Path to output Nexus tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`. With multiple `--output-nwk-style` values, a secondary extension is inserted per style.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree auspice
settings.help: Path to output Auspice v2 JSON tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree MAT protobuf
settings.help: Path to output UShER MAT protobuf tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree MAT JSON
settings.help: Path to output UShER MAT JSON tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree graph JSON
settings.help: Path to output internal graph JSON tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree DOT
settings.help: Path to output Graphviz DOT tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output files
settings.help: Comma-separated list of outputs to produce with `--output-all`.
settings.more:
Restricts which outputs `--output-all` writes. Special value `all` expands to every output available for this command. Requires `--output-all`. Per-file flags are always honored regardless of this selection.

A selected output that the run has no data for is skipped without a message, for example the substitution model of a run that fits none. A per-file flag for such an output fails.

settings.label: Ladderize
settings.help: Order tree topology before writing output files.

settings.label: Topology order
settings.help: Canonical topology ordering preset.

settings.label: Topology order target source
settings.help: Source for target-order topology sorting.

settings.label: Topology order target file
settings.help: File used by list or reference-topology target-order sources.

settings.label: Topology order target aggregate
settings.help: Aggregate used to map a subtree to a target-order position.

settings.label: Seed
settings.help: Random seed
settings.more: Without a seed, a run with a random step draws one and logs it, so the run can be reproduced.

settings.label: Zero based
settings.help: Zero-based mutation indexing

settings.label: Ignore missing alignments
settings.help: Treat tree tips that have no sequence in the alignment as fully ambiguous (missing data) instead of aborting.
settings.more: Without this flag the run aborts when more than one third of the tips lack a sequence, matching TreeTime v0. Useful when consuming per-CDS translations where some samples have no peptide for a given CDS.

settings.label: Translations
settings.help: Path template for per-CDS amino-acid FASTA alignments.
settings.more: The template must contain a CDS placeholder, replaced with each value from `--cdses` (or each CDS in `--annotation` when `--cdses` is omitted). Both `{cds}` (Nextclade `--output-translations`) and `%GENE` (augur) placeholders are accepted.

settings.label: CDSes
settings.help: Comma-separated CDS names to reconstruct from `--translations`.
settings.more: When omitted, the CDS set is derived from `--annotation`.

settings.label: Annotation
settings.help: GFF3 file with CDS coordinates for Augur node data annotations.
settings.more: Also supplies the CDS set when `--cdses` is omitted.

settings.label: Amino-acid
settings.help: Use amino-acid alphabet (v0 compat, equivalent to `--alphabet=aa`)

settings.label: Substitution model

options.help: Infer GTR parameters from data via Fitch parsimony substitution counts.

settings.help: Substitution model to use
settings.more: `--model infer` infers a model from the data. Alternatively, specify the model type. If the specified model requires additional options, use `--model-params` to specify those.

settings.label: Model params
settings.help: Parameters for the model selected by `--model`, given as a `key=value` list
settings.more: Example: `--model k80 --model-params kappa=0.2 pis=0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25`.

settings.label: Amino-acid model

options.help: Infer an amino-acid GTR from the data over the stop-inclusive alphabet. Matches augur.
Jones-Taylor-Thornton 1992 empirical 20-amino-acid model (no stop codon). Stop codons and any other out-of-alphabet characters in the input are mapped to the unknown state `X`.

settings.help: Amino-acid substitution model. Mirrors the nucleotide `--model`; default `infer` matches augur.

settings.label: GTR iterations
settings.help: Number of outer GTR refinement iterations.
settings.more: Re-estimates the rate matrix from marginal posterior profiles after each reconstruction pass. Only effective with `--model infer`. Default 0 preserves the current single-pass behavior. Mugration uses 5 by default.

settings.label: Site specific GTR
settings.help: Use site-specific GTR model with per-site equilibrium frequencies.
settings.more: Requires `--model infer` and `--dense true`. Incompatible with sequence compression (sparse representation). When enabled, each alignment position gets its own eigendecomposition based on position-specific base composition.

settings.label: Custom GTR
settings.help: Load a custom GTR model from file (not yet implemented)

settings.label: Ancestral method
settings.help: Method used for reconstructing ancestral sequences

settings.label: Dense
settings.help: Use dense representation (stores full probability vectors at each position)
settings.more: When combined with `--model infer`, marginal reconstruction runs twice: once to populate profiles for GTR inference, and again with the inferred GTR.

settings.label: Gap fill
settings.help: How to handle gap characters in input sequences
settings.more: 'only-terminal': replace leading and trailing gap characters with the ambiguous character (default, matches v0). 'all': replace all gap characters with the ambiguous character. 'none': leave all gap characters unchanged.

settings.label: Keep overhangs
settings.help: Do not fill terminal gaps (deprecated: use --gap-fill=none)

settings.label: Include leaves
settings.help: Emit reconstructed leaf (tip) sequences in addition to internal nodes.

settings.label: Impute missing data
settings.help: Resolve ambiguous and unknown tip states (`N` and IUPAC codes such as `R`) to the most likely inferred state.
settings.more: Gaps are left as deletions (inferred structure, not missing data). Only defined for marginal reconstruction; a no-op with a warning under `--method-anc=parsimony`.

settings.label: Reconstruct tip states
settings.help: v0-compatible alias for `--include-leaves --impute-missing-data`.
settings.more: Emits tip sequences and resolves ambiguous/unknown tip states to the most likely inferred state.

settings.label: Report ambiguous
settings.help: Include branch mutations from or to the fully ambiguous state (`N` for nucleotides, `X` for amino acids).
settings.more: By default these mutations are omitted from the branch mutations of the Newick and Nexus annotations, the Auspice JSON, and the `muts` and `aa_muts` lists of augur node data. Other ambiguity codes, such as `K` or `R`, are always reported. The flag does not affect the MAT outputs, which store `N` as missing data and never contain these mutations, or the root `aa_muts` of augur node data, which list the differences between the `--aa-root-sequence` reference and the inferred root and always omit `X` and gaps.

settings.label: Amino-acid root sequence
settings.help: FASTA file with one amino-acid root/reference sequence per CDS.

settings.label: Marginal
settings.help: Shortcut for `--method-anc=marginal` (v0 compat)

settings.label: Sample from profile
settings.help: How to pick ancestral states from the marginal posterior profile.
settings.more:
'argmax': most likely state at every node (deterministic, default). 'root': sample from the posterior at the root only, argmax elsewhere (matches augur's `sample_from_profile='root'`). Use `--seed` for reproducible draws. 'all': sample from the posterior at every node.

Only affects marginal reconstruction (`--method-anc=marginal`).

settings.help: Path to output augur-compatible node data JSON.
settings.more:
Contains per-node nucleotide mutations, reconstructed sequences, the alignment mask, genome annotations, and the reference (root) sequence. The output is compatible with augur export v2 --node-data for Nextstrain pipeline integration.

settings.label: Output reconstructed amino-acid fasta
settings.help: Path template for per-CDS reconstructed amino-acid FASTA output (including internal nodes).
settings.more:
Off by default. When set, the reconstructed sequence of every node is written per CDS. The file name accepts the `{cds}`/`%GENE` placeholders of `--translations`, and needs one when more than one CDS is reconstructed; folder names are used as given.

An output that the run has no data for is skipped without a message, for example the substitution model of a run that fits none. A per-file flag for such an output fails.

settings.label: DP
settings.help: Likelihood convergence threshold. The loop stops when successive likelihoods differ by less than this value, or when a 2-cycle with amplitude below this value is detected.

settings.label: Damping
settings.help: Damping factor $d$ for outer-loop updates: $b=b_{new}(1-d)+b_{old}d$, where $d=max(damping^{i+1},0.01)$. Higher values reduce oscillation; zero disables damping. Must be in $[0,1)$.

settings.label: Branch length initial guess

options.help: Estimate only edges with missing or invalid branch lengths, preserve valid input values. No-op when all edges have finite branch lengths.
Estimate all edges, overwriting input branch lengths.
Use input branch lengths as-is. Fails if any edge has a missing or invalid branch length.

settings.help: Initial branch length estimate before Newton optimization.
settings.more: - auto: estimate only edges with missing or invalid branch lengths, preserve valid input values (default) - always: estimate all edges, overwriting input branch lengths - never: use input branch lengths as-is; fails if any are missing

settings.label: Optimization method
settings.help: Per-edge optimizer and parameterization. Values are `brent`, `brent-sqrt` (default and v0-compatible), `brent-log`, `newton`, `newton-sqrt`, and `newton-log`; suffixes select $\sqrt{t}$ or $\ln(t)$.

settings.label: No indels
settings.help: Disable indel (insertion/deletion) contributions to branch-length optimization.
settings.more: When set, the optimizer uses substitution-only likelihood, matching standard phylogenetic tools (RAxML, IQ-TREE, PhyML, BEAST) and enabling v0 parity testing. Default: indels enabled.

settings.label: No collapse short branches
settings.help: Disable collapsing of internal branches whose optimized length is zero.
settings.more: By default the optimize loop contracts internal edges the per-edge optimizer drove to exactly zero that carry no substitutions or indels, turning the resulting binary nodes into polytomies. When set, such edges are kept in the output tree with length zero.

settings.label: No merge siblings
settings.help: Disable merging of polytomy siblings that share substitutions.
settings.more: By default, sibling branches in a polytomy that carry identical substitutions are grouped under a new internal node. Requires the sparse sequence representation, so this step has no effect under `--dense` and the flag is then a no-op.

settings.label: No flip parent child
settings.help: Disable the flip-parent-child step (reversion hoist) in polytomies.
settings.more: By default, when a child branch carries the exact reversion of a substitution on the node's parent branch, a new node is inserted that groups the node with that child, removing one mutation per reverted position. When set, those reversions are left in place. Requires the sparse sequence representation, so this step has no effect under `--dense` and the flag is then a no-op.

settings.label: Reroot method
settings.help: Reroot the tree by minimizing root-to-tip divergence variance.
settings.more: By default, optimize keeps the input root. Pass --reroot or --reroot=min-dev to enable divergence-based rerooting. Date-dependent methods (least-squares, oldest, clock-filter) are available in the timetree and clock commands.

settings.label: Reroot tips
settings.help: Reroot on the branch leading to a tip or the MRCA of a comma-separated tip list.

settings.label: Keep root
settings.help: Keep the input tree root instead of rerooting.
settings.more: Optimize keeps the input root by default; this flag is the explicit form and is mutually exclusive with the reroot options.

commands.title: Prune tree
commands.description: Collapse short or empty branches and remove listed samples.

settings.label: Alignment
settings.help: Aligned FASTA input. Accepts multiple plain or compressed (`gz`, `bz2`, `xz`, `zstd`) files and detects compression by extension. The records of all files form one alignment. Use `-` to read uncompressed FASTA from standard input.

settings.label: Tree
settings.help: Tree in Newick format.

settings.label: Alphabet
settings.help: Sequence alphabet
settings.more: When omitted, the alphabet is auto-detected from sequence content and falls back to `nuc` when detection is ambiguous.

settings.label: Output all
settings.help: Write all default output files into this directory.
settings.more:
Produces the default set of tree and non-tree outputs for the command, using `<dir>/<command>.<ext>` paths. Combine with `--output-selection` to restrict which outputs are written.

Per-file flags (`--output-tree-nwk`, `--output-augur-node-data`, etc.) override or supplement the files produced by `--output-all`.

An output that the run has no data for is skipped without a message, for example the substitution model of a run that fits none. A per-file flag for such an output fails.

settings.label: Newick style
settings.help: NWK/Nexus annotation styles to write (comma-separated): `plain`, `beast`, `nhx`.
settings.more: Applies to every NWK and Nexus output. With more than one style, files are distinguished by a secondary extension (`.annotated` for beast, `.nhx` for nhx). Default: `plain`.

settings.label: Output tree Newick
settings.help: Path to output Newick tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`. With multiple `--output-nwk-style` values, a secondary extension is inserted per style.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree nexus
settings.help: Path to output Nexus tree file.
settings.more:
Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`. With multiple `--output-nwk-style` values, a secondary extension is inserted per style.

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output. Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.label: Output tree auspice
settings.help: Path to output Auspice v2 JSON tree file.
settings.more:

Parent directories are created if missing.

settings.more:

settings.label: Output GTR
settings.help: Path to output GTR model JSON.
settings.more: Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

settings.label: Output files
settings.help: Comma-separated list of outputs to produce with `--output-all`.
settings.more:
Restricts which outputs `--output-all` writes. Special value `all` expands to every output available for this command. Requires `--output-all`. Per-file flags are always honored regardless of this selection.

A selected output that the run has no data for is skipped without a message, for example the substitution model of a run that fits none. A per-file flag for such an output fails.

settings.label: Ladderize
settings.help: Order tree topology before writing output files.

settings.label: Topology order
settings.help: Canonical topology ordering preset.

settings.label: Topology order target source
settings.help: Source for target-order topology sorting.

settings.label: Topology order target file
settings.help: File used by list or reference-topology target-order sources.

settings.label: Topology order target aggregate
settings.help: Aggregate used to map a subtree to a target-order position.

settings.label: Prune short
settings.help: Threshold value for pruning of branches
settings.more: If set, prune branches with a length below this value

settings.label: Prune empty
settings.help: Prune empty branches
settings.more:
If set, prune any branch that does not have a mutation or other state transition mapped to it.

Requires --alignment

settings.label: Merge shared mutations
settings.help: Merge branches in polytomies that share identical mutations
settings.more:
When sibling branches in a polytomy (node with >2 children) carry identical substitutions, they are grouped under a new internal node. The shared mutations move to the new branch (parent to new node), and only unique mutations remain on children's edges. Reduces tree builder artifacts from arbitrary binary resolution of polytomies.

Requires --alignment

settings.label: Prune nodes list
settings.help: List of node names to prune
settings.more:
List of node names to remove from the tree, comma-separated (,)

Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and empty names are ignored. Use --prune-nodes-list-delimiter to specify a different delimiter.

settings.label: Prune nodes list delimiter
settings.help: Name separator for `--prune-nodes-list`
settings.more: String used to separate node names in the list given to (--prune-nodes-list). Make sure to correctly quote and escape the delimiter according to your shell.

settings.label: Prune nodes list file
settings.help: File containing list of node names to prune
settings.more:
Path to a file containing node names to remove from the tree, newline-delimited (\n). Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and empty names are ignored.

Use '-' to read from standard input (stdin).

Use --prune-nodes-list-file-delimiter to specify a different delimiter.

settings.label: Prune nodes list file delimiter
settings.help: Separator for node names in the list file
settings.more: Character or string used to separate node names in the list file.
